data.one_liner: Preview local files with Apple's native Quick Look on iOS.
data.what_it_does: Provides an interface to Apple's native QLPreviewController on iOS to preview single or multiple local files. Includes capability checks, swipe-to-dismiss control, and handles paths with special characters.
use_when: You need to preview local files like PDFs or images natively on iOS.
You want to allow users to swipe through a collection of local documents.
avoid_when: You need support for Android, Web, or desktop platforms.
You need to preview remote files directly via HTTP URLs without downloading them first.
strengths: Uses Apple's native Quick Look controller.
Supports multiple files and custom dismiss controls.
weaknesses: iOS only; calls on other platforms fail.
Requires Swift Package Manager and does not support CocoaPods.
data.setup_notes: Requires Flutter 3.44+ and Dart 3.12+, Swift Package Manager enabled, and iOS 13+.
